privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: How Healuxa collects, uses and protects your personal data.

controller.title: Who we are
controller.body: Healuxa operates this platform and is responsible for the personal data described in this notice. Contact details are on our contact page.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body:
Account data (email or phone number and a securely hashed password), booking and concierge request details you provide, communication preferences and consent choices, and technical data needed to keep your session secure (such as IP address and sign-in times).

We do not ask for clinical information in concierge requests.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body: To provide your account, bookings and concierge service, to verify practitioners and facilities, to send service messages and — only with your consent — marketing, and to keep the platform secure.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: The practitioner and facility you book with receive the details needed for your appointment. Payment processors receive payment data directly from you. We do not sell personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep data for as long as your account is active and as required by applicable law, then delete or anonymise it.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can access, correct and delete your data, withdraw consent at any time and object to certain processing, subject to applicable law in the UAE and, where relevant, the EU GDPR.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact us using the details on the contact page.

service.title: Our service
service.body: Healuxa is a platform that lists verified practitioners and facilities and coordinates bookings and logistics. We are not a healthcare provider.

noAdvice.title: No medical advice
noAdvice.body: Nothing on Healuxa is medical advice. Clinical decisions are made between you and your clinician. In an emergency, call 998 or 999.

providers.title: Practitioners and facilities
providers.body: We verify licences before publishing profiles, but practitioners and facilities remain responsible for the care they provide.

accounts.title: Your account
accounts.body: Keep your credentials secure and tell us about any unauthorised use. You can sign out other devices from your account.

fees.title: Fees and payments
fees.body: Prices show the professional fee and the facility fee. Taxes and any platform fees are shown before payment. Cancellation and refund rules are shown before you confirm.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, Healuxa is not liable for the clinical services provided by practitioners or facilities.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates, unless mandatory local law provides otherwise.

cookies.title: Cookie notice
cookies.lead: The cookies Healuxa uses and why.

what.title: What cookies are
what.body: Cookies are small files stored by your browser. We use as few as possible.

essential.title: Essential cookies
essential.body: Secure, http-only cookies keep you signed in and protect forms against cross-site request forgery. The service cannot work without them.

preferences.title: Preference cookies
preferences.body: We remember your language and display theme, and the facilities you manage on this device.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We do not use third-party advertising or analytics cookies.

manage.title: Managing cookies
manage.body: You can delete cookies in your browser settings. Deleting essential cookies signs you out.

meta.homeTitle: Healuxa — private healthcare concierge in the UAE
meta.homeDescription: Find verified doctors and clinics in the UAE, see transparent fees and let a multilingual concierge coordinate your care.
meta.defaultDescription: Verified providers, transparent fees and a multilingual healthcare concierge in the UAE.

home.title: Care arranged around you, with verified specialists
home.lead: Search licensed doctors and clinics, compare transparent fees and let a dedicated coordinator handle the logistics — in English, Arabic or Persian.
home.trust1: Practitioner licences are verified with the issuing health authority before a profile is published.
home.trust2: Clinics and hospitals are listed only after their facility licence is verified.
home.trust3: Prices show the clinician’s fee and the facility fee separately.

verified.title: Verified practitioners
verified.body: Only licensed, verified practitioners and facilities appear in our directory.

transparent.title: Transparent fees
transparent.body: See the professional and facility fee before you book — no hidden referral commissions.

concierge.title: A real concierge
concierge.body: A coordinator helps with appointments, travel logistics and languages, from first request to follow-up.

home.featuredEmpty: Our directory is opening soon. Contact the concierge and we will help you directly.
home.partnersTitle: Are you a practitioner or a facility?
home.partnersBody: Apply to join Healuxa. We verify credentials, publish your profile and services, and send you booking requests.

how.title: How the concierge works
how.lead: One point of contact from your first question to your appointment and beyond.

request.title: 1. Tell us what you need
request.body:
Send a concierge request with your preferred dates, city and languages. You don’t need to share medical details — a coordinator only needs to understand the logistics.

You can also search the directory and book a verified provider yourself.

match.title: 2. We propose options
match.body: Your coordinator suggests verified practitioners and facilities that fit your request, with their fees shown transparently. You choose.

coordinate.title: 3. We coordinate
coordinate.body: We arrange the appointment request, answer your questions through secure messaging and keep you updated by your preferred channel.

after.title: 4. After your visit
after.body: Your booking history, invoices and messages stay in your account. Clinical decisions always remain between you and your clinician.

travel.title: Medical travel coordination
travel.lead: Practical help for patients travelling to the UAE for care: scheduling, logistics and language support.

scope.title: What we coordinate
scope.body: Appointment scheduling with verified providers, interpreters, local transport and accommodation suggestions, and timing of visits around your travel dates.

before.title: Before you travel
before.body: Share your travel window and preferred city. Your coordinator proposes providers and confirms availability before you book flights.

during.title: During your stay
during.body: Your coordinator is reachable through secure messaging for logistics questions and changes to your schedule.

after.title: After you return
after.body: Invoices and booking records remain available in your account.

limits.title: What we do not do
limits.body: Healuxa does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and does not guarantee clinical outcomes. Visa and insurance decisions remain with the relevant authorities and insurers.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Answers to common questions about Healuxa.

what.a: Healuxa is a healthcare concierge platform in the UAE. We list verified practitioners and facilities and help you coordinate appointments and logistics.

verified.a: Practitioners submit their professional licence, which our team checks with the issuing health authority (for example DHA, DOH or MOHAP). Facilities are verified against their facility licence.

fees.a: Each service shows the clinician’s professional fee and the facility fee separately, together with the total. Any taxes are shown before you pay.

languages.a: The platform is available in English, Arabic and Persian. Provider profiles list the languages each practitioner speaks.

travel.q: Can you help if I am travelling from abroad?
travel.a: Yes. Submit a concierge request with your travel dates and a coordinator will help with scheduling and logistics.

emergency.q: Can I use Healuxa in an emergency?
emergency.a: No. In an emergency in the UAE call 998 for an ambulance or 999 for the police.

data.a: Your session is protected with secure, http-only cookies, and we never ask for clinical information in concierge requests. See the privacy notice for details.

providers.q: I am a practitioner. How do I join?
providers.a: Create an account, apply as a practitioner and submit your licence. Once verified and activated, your profile becomes visible in the directory.

contact.title: Contact the concierge
contact.lead: Reach our team directly. We usually reply within one business day.
contact.hours: Support hours: Sunday to Thursday, 9:00–18:00 (UAE time).
contact.privacyHint: Please don’t send medical records or clinical details by email.
